scope: one rank/GPU per node, one CXI NIC per rank pair

deployment_constraints.note: proxy producer concurrency is bounded by min(grid_blocks, proxy_worker_lanes)

action_notes.proxy: device pushes commands into CPU-worker rings; concurrent blocks can issue on distinct lanes
action_notes.trigger: host stages descriptors serially and one MMIO trigger releases the batch
action_notes.ipc: same-node path only; force only when compiler/runtime topology proves the peer mapping
